title: Different animated borders in the same map

posts.author: Malloy
posts.body:
Hello everybody.
I have a question.
I want to create a small island with two different borders on it:
A grass border. This will be filled with grass.
A sand border. I created this one with Gimp. This will be filled with sand.
I don’t think I am asking a lot, but I don’t know how to do it (shift mapping seems a hassle).
I experimented a bit, but to no avail. RPG maker always gives me either the grass border or the sand border.
=> So is it possible to have 2 different borders on the same map on the same water ?
Since the grass border and the sand border are next to the animated water, I take it the 2 borders must be placed in A1, but I am not sure.
If it is possible, in which tileset and section do I place the grass border, and in which tileset and section do I place the sand border, so that both can be separately used on the same map on the same animated water ? And I guess I have to use both of them in the bottom layer ?
If someone can show me the way, because it is a bit confusing for me.
Thanks in advance.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: I made a map 2 years ago, but did you check the editor Help Menu -> contents -> documentation -> asset standards: Tileset Details ?

posts.body:
Sorry for the late reply.
I checked as much as I could, including the manuals and tutorials, but I didn't find a solution.
